w: At 6.45 p.m., Swamishri arrived in a public satsang assembly where he was honored by officials of the Surendranagar - Dudhrej Municipality. Swamishri was garlanded and offered a plaque of honor. Then various organizations and heads of different Indian communities offered bouquets to Swamishri and honored him. In conclusion Swamishri blessed the assembly.
Prior to the evening assembly the members of the Surendranagar-Dhudhrej Municipality and Pujya Viveksagar Swami attended the naming ceremony of a main street in Surendranagar as 'Pramukh Swami Marg'.

ds.t: "If you get a lowly task, count it your good fortune..."
w: The spiritual atmosphere that Pramukh Swami Maharaj has created in India and abroad is a new revolution. In this age of selfishness, through the touch of Swamishri, the embodiment of selfless service, how eager thousands of satsangis, men and women young and old, remain for seva! One such example is Dr Rajiv Vyas. This prosperous doctor of Cherry Hill has 800 people working under him and 38 doctors working as his assistants. He is also a director at a well known hospital in New Jersey. Yet every morning he comes to the Cherry Hill mandir for the darshan of Thakorji and, with devotion, cleans the mandir's toilets and bathrooms every day!
Pleased with Dr Rajiv Vyas, Swamishri said, "In God's court everyone is small. If we do seva in this way, God is pleased and ego does not come either."
"If you get a lowly task, count it your good fortune..." Swamishri has nurtured thousands of such devotees who bring this line of Muktanand Swami to life. That is the magic of his saintliness.

A youth narrated his dream to Swamishri, “A few days ago Maharaj and you appeared to me in a dream. It was morning time. You said something to me but at that time my eyes opened. Since then I have been wanting to ask you what instruction you had given.” Swamishri replied, “Do satsang properly, do your work or business properly and observe dharma sincerely.” Swamishri gave a simple formula for happy living.
If there is spirituality along with modernity then there will be peace. If not then our society will become inclined towards evil and in doing bad things to each other. (1 June 2005, Bhavnagar)
Do things related to dharma immediately and ask five people before doing mundane things. (2 June 2005, Bhavnagar)
God is our true asset. If we look after it we will experience happiness and peace. (3 June 2005, Bhavnagar)
One has to become an expert in worldly affairs, but along with that one must have spirituality.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
23 May 2005, Bhavnagar
A two-year-old child observed an 84-hour fast, taking only liquid.
A 58-year-old volunteer and his wife observed a liquid fast for 26 days.
29 May 2005, Bhavnagar
Three devotees pilgrimaged by foot and 24 youths cycled from Talaja.
3 June 2005, Bhavnagar
Forty-nine devotees from Mandva two from Manar, nine from Shihor and one from Lilivav pilgrimaged by foot to Bhavnagar.

This morning devotees of Mombasa and from other places held a symbolic celebration of Swamishri’s birthday. On Swamishri’s arrival for his morning puja balloons rained from the entire marquee and everyone sang and wished Swamishri a happy birthday. In the evening celebration assembly senior sadhus extolled Swamishri’s saintliness. The youths of Mombasa Satsang Mandal enacted a drama on Alexander the Great’s encounters in India. Jaydeep Swadia sang bhajans and senior sadhus honoured Swamishri with garlands. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, “From the day we landed in Africa there has been joy, joy and joy. The love of the devotees is profuse and full of enthusiasm. Shriji Maharaj has said that people love festivals and discourses because it bonds them with God. Therefore one must participate for the purpose of pleasing God. Devotees have always had one goal and that is to please God. When God is pleased he blesses us with the happiness of this world and his abode hereafter.”

Swamishri was in a happy, divine mood because it was Yogi Jayanti. While Swamishri was doing darshan and pradakshina of the Smruti Mandir, the sadhus sang “Yogi ãvo te rang mune shid lagãdyo…” and played kartal. After reaching the puja stage Swamishri was given the kartal and he devotionally played them before the murti of Yogiji Maharaj. During puja sadhus sang bhajans in praise of Yogiji Maharaj. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the Yogi Jayanti assembly, “ Yogiji Maharaj often sang ‘Hãji bhalã sadhu…’ He would sway while singing, absorbed in the murti of Maharaj. He possessed all divine virtues. He was the living form of God. There were no fallacies in him. Once, while he was travelling to a village he could not get any water to offer Thakorji along the way. When he came across a river he bathed Thakorji in its cool waters, offered water and prayed for forgiveness. He was forever absorbed in Bhagwan’s murti, service and bhakti. He never got angry at all. It was not in his dictionary. He was indifferent to honour and insult. He never thought ill of anyone. He always uttered, ‘May God do good of all.’ “We have got this human birth to become aksharrup and offer bhakti to Purushottam. And not to eat and enjoy worldly pleasures.” Swamishri was garlanded by senior sadhus and in conclusion he performed the Yogi Jayanti arti.
Prior to his morning puja Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of pujan, arti and mantra-pushpanjali of the murtis for BAPS hari mandirs in St. Louis (USA) and Chachana.

Today, in the 'Abhishek Mandapam', the murtis for the newly built BAPS Swaminarayan mandir in the city of St Louis in America had been placed. Pramukh Swami Maharaj was to perform the preliminary worship of these murtis before their installation. For this, Dr Pranavbhai and other devotees had come especially for the occasion. After performing the Vedic rites, Swamishri left, but while going up into the mandir, Swamishri said to Santswarup Swami, "These devotees have come, so take care of their snacks and refreshments, also arrange their lunch, and make everyone happy."

Batuksinh Rathod of Mojidad is well disposed towards satsang. Hearing the news of the installation at the Limbdi mandir, he kept thinking, "Does God really come and reside in a murti just by performing such rites? This is all a sham." Such thoughts of disbelief kept arising in his mind; but in some pure moment the thought came to him, "Rather than saying that God definitely does not exist, perhaps he does, so let us test him." Thinking this, he made a wish: "A piece of business work has been stuck for fifteen years. If God really comes to reside in the murti, let my work succeed." He made this wish on the morning of the installation, and a miracle happened: that very evening his work was completed! The work that had been stuck for fifteen years was completed in a matter of hours. He himself could not believe it. He was amazed, but one thing became firm for him: only a great sadhu like Pramukh Swami can infuse life into a murti, and only then does God surely reside in the mandir. Today he had come especially to receive Swamishri's blessings.

Batuksinh Rathod of Mojidad is a well wisher. On hearing the news of the installation at the Limbdi mandir, he kept thinking, "Does Bhagwan really come to reside in a murti just by performing such rituals? All this is a sham." Such thoughts of disbelief kept arising in his mind; but at some pure moment the thought came to him, "Rather than saying that Bhagwan simply does not exist, if perhaps he does, let me test him." Thinking this, he made a resolve, "A piece of work for my business has been stuck for fifteen years. If Bhagwan truly comes to reside in the murti, may my work succeed." He made this resolve on the morning of the installation, and a miracle happened; that very evening his work was completed! Work that had been stuck for fifteen years was completed in hours. He himself could not believe it. He was amazed, but one thing became firm for him, that only a great sant like Pramukh Swami can infuse life into a murti, and only then does the Lord truly reside in the mandir. Today he had come especially to receive Pramukh Swami Maharaj's blessings.

Today, after Mahant Swami Maharaj had his midday meal, the sadhus gave a beautiful presentation on how the interpretations of the Shrimad Bhagavat given in the Vachanamrut are special, distinctive and awe inspiring compared with other commentaries.

Pleased, Swamishri said, "The Vachanamrut is the essence of all scriptures. Gunatitanand Swami found four points in it: commands, upasana, love for the great ekantik sadhu, and friendliness towards devotees of Bhagwan; and he said these four talks are the life of the soul. And Yogi Bapa pointed out just one point even from these, saying, 'If friendliness towards devotees of Bhagwan alone comes, the other three are included in it.' We wonder, how are commands and upasana included in this? How is love for the ekantik sadhu included? But Yogi Bapa has said it, so if there is friendliness towards the devotees of Bhagwan, the whole Bhagavat and all the scriptures will be included."
